bootstrap.method: paired item bootstrap of the ratio

holm: NOT computed here. The version string previously said 'and-holm', which was misleading. Holm-adjusted p-values already existed in b14_posthoc_2x2_reanalysis_v1.json (holm_adjusted_edge_family) and b15_analysis_v1.json (holm_secondary); the paper prints those.
note: v1 bootstrapped the numerator only. Resampling items and recomputing the whole ratio is the correct interval for a share.
